author: HopeTech
name: HopeTech.Common resource contracts
description: The HTTP contracts for one resource and the validator beside them: a create request, a response, and one FluentValidation validator. Together with htc-service and htc-controller this composes to what htc-resource emits in one go.

rootNamespace.description: Read from the host project's RootNamespace. Resolves only in a project that has been restored.

skipValidator.description: Omit the validator. Only correct when the request carries no rules at all.
